key_facts: Previous treatments included systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, tofacitinib, rituximab, and IVIG
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles on nailfold examination
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)

raw.rationale: The presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, elevated serum IFN-β levels, and specific clinical features such as violaceous erythema, poikiloderma, and nailfold capillary changes are characteristic of juvenile dermatomyositis, with the specific autoantibody pointing towards Anti-TIF-1γ JDM.

rejected.label: Juvenile Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: While the clinical presentation is consistent with JDM, the presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies specifies the diagnosis further to Anti-TIF-1γ JDM.

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The clinical and laboratory findings, particularly the presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies and the specific pattern of skin and muscle involvement, are more consistent with Anti-TIF-1γ JDM than SLE.
